chunks: The addressee (in this verse) is devoid of argument and his excuse is most deceptive. He is detaining himself in ignorance.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a person is described as having a refuted argument and remaining in self-ignorance?
ai.summary: In the context of the Khutbah of Exegesis (Tafsir Ayat 82:6), Imam Ali (AS) identifies the hypocrites as those who are most defeated in argument and clearest in their self-deception, emphasizing that their failure stems from a fundamental lack of self-knowledge. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that true victory lies not merely in rhetorical skill but in recognizing one's own spiritual deficiencies, a theme deeply rooted in the concept of 'Ma'rifat al-Nafs' (knowledge of the self).
